title: Choosing a Career
text:
Many young people finish school and think about their future. Some want to go to university to study medicine or engineering. Others prefer to learn a job at a technical school. Choosing a career can be difficult.

Good teachers can help students make this choice. They talk about the interests and skills of each student. Many students also do an internship at a company. This experience helps them learn what they enjoy.

questions.text: What do some young people want to study at university?
What can good teachers talk about with students?
Why might an internship be useful for a student?
options: It helps the student learn what they enjoy
It removes the need for exams
It is only useful for teachers

questions.text: How does the author probably feel about choosing a career?
options: It is a decision that needs thought
It is not important at all
It should be made by parents only

vocabulary.definition: the job or series of jobs a person does over their working life
things that a person likes to do or learn about
a period of work experience at a company, often for students
abilities that a person has learned to do well

paragraph_translations: Muitos jovens terminam a escola e pensam no seu futuro. Alguns querem ir para a universidade para estudar medicina ou engenharia. Outros preferem aprender uma profissão em uma escola técnica. Escolher uma carreira pode ser difícil.

Bons professores podem ajudar os alunos a fazer essa escolha. Eles conversam sobre os interesses e as habilidades de cada aluno. Muitos alunos também fazem um estágio em uma empresa. Essa experiência ajuda a descobrir o que eles gostam.
